# Page X

PageX is an all-in-one platform combining CRM, page builder, and online course builder to help businesses manage leads, build websites, and create courses.

Category: Sales & CRM. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/page-x/.

## Actions

- **Delete Incident**: Delete an incident by id.
- **Delete Incident**: Delete an incident by id.
- **Get Incident by ID** (read-only): Fetch incident details by id.
- **List Incidents** (read-only): List incidents.
- **Pagex Client Request**: Execute a generic request to the pagerduty api.
